name: capacities-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your Capacities knowledge base for searching, reading, and saving content.
long_description:
Access your Capacities knowledge management system directly from Claude. Search across spaces, read object content, save weblinks, and add notes to your daily journal - all through natural language:
* **Search your knowledge base** - Find content across all your Capacities spaces
* **Read full content** - Retrieve the complete content of any object by ID
* **Save weblinks** - Bookmark URLs with custom titles, descriptions, and tags
* **Daily notes** - Add markdown content to today's daily note
* **Space management** - List and explore your Capacities spaces and structures

tools.name: capacities_search
tools.description: Search for content across Capacities spaces with optional filtering

tools.name: capacities_read_object_content
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a Capacities object by its ID

tools.name: capacities_append_to_daily_note
tools.description: Append markdown to the daily note for a given day (defaults to today), creating it automatically if it doesn't exist yet

tools.name: capacities_get_daily_note
tools.description: Find and read the daily note for a given day (defaults to today)

tools.name: capacities_get_object_type_shape
tools.description: List object types with writable properties and collections

tools.name: capacities_get_space
tools.description: Get info about the space the token is scoped to

tools.name: capacities_get_object_link
tools.description: Retrieve an object and generate a link to it

tools.name: capacities_create_page
tools.description: Create a new Page object with markdown content

tools.name: capacities_create_task
tools.description: Create a Task object with status, priority, and dates

tools.name: capacities_create_object
tools.description: Create any object type using markdown with YAML frontmatter

tools.name: capacities_create_from_url
tools.description: Save a URL as a weblink object (replaces save_weblink)

tools.name: capacities_append_to_object
tools.description: Append markdown to the body of an existing object

tools.name: capacities_update_object
tools.description: Update writable properties via YAML frontmatter

tools.name: capacities_update_block
tools.description: Replace the content of a single block

tools.name: capacities_delete_object
tools.description: Delete an object (trash by default, optional permanent delete)

tools.name: capacities_list_objects_by_type
tools.description: List objects of a given type (paginated)

tools.name: capacities_list_objects_by_tag
tools.description: List objects with a given tag (paginated)
